title: Film area calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the film area in m² from the grid count and side length.

title: Oleic acid concentration
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the volume fraction of oleic acid in the stock solution.

title: Volume per drop
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the volume of pure oleic acid in a single drop.

title: Molecular diameter formula
description: Essential: The student must apply the correct model, d = V / S, to estimate the molecular diameter.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should demonstrate consistent unit conversions to meters, liters, etc.

title: Grid counting error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect grid count or misinterprets the film boundary.

title: Concentration misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the 0.6 mL/1000 mL ratio (e.g., treating it as 0.6% instead of 0.06%).

title: Volume per drop logic
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the volume of 50 drops with the volume per drop for the pure acid calculation.
